# Validator Guide

## 1. Test the released system first

Complete the fixed protocol before tuning, modifying or replacing components.

## 2. Preserve evidence

Keep environment details, package or commit identifier, raw output, result files, failure traces and protocol deviations.

Report positive, null and negative findings.

## 3. Suggest an improvement

Create a new folder under `suggested_improvements/` and include executable code where possible.

## 4. Do not edit another validator's folder

Each proposal should remain attributable and reproducible.

## 5. Pull request review

A pull request into this public repository means only that the proposal becomes visible for review. It does not mean the proposal has been incorporated into PXOL.
